facts.fact: INSTAT reports that two specialised commissions of the National Statistics Council validated the final evaluation report of the third Schema Directeur de la Statistique (SDS 2020-2024) on 6-7 February 2025.
INSTAT's Director General asked statistical bodies to list their activities and indicators in prelude to drawing up the action plan of the SDS 2025-2029.
